description: Detects weak or broken cryptography that lets attackers recover plaintext passwords, forge tokens, or decrypt sensitive data. Use when writing code that encrypts or decrypts data, hashes passwords or tokens, generates random values for security purposes, manages cryptographic keys, or configures TLS/SSL settings. Also invoke when storing sensitive data at rest.
